headword: フランス{料理|りょうり}

definitions.explanation: The culinary tradition of France, considered one of the world's great cuisines and known for elaborate technique and refined presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧フランス{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We went to eat French cuisine for my birthday.

examples.english: A full course of French cuisine includes many dishes from appetizer to dessert, so it is meant to be enjoyed slowly over time.

notes:
French cuisine is widely regarded in Japan as sophisticated and special-occasion dining. It was introduced to Japan during the Meiji era and has deeply influenced ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western-style Japanese cooking).
